entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk Planeswalker from Zendikar who summons sea-beasts, posed as the navigator Callaphe on Theros, and steals Thassa's bident.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The sea god of Theros who fights Kiora with her kraken armies and her bident.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A human Planeswalker traveling on the Monsoon toward Kruphix's temple; Thassa calls her the Betrayer.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin Planeswalker who suspected Kiora was not Callaphe and travels with Elspeth.

entities.name: Arixmethes
entities.description: A colossal kraken mistaken for an island with a ruined city on its back, whom Kiora seeks to bond with but who sides with Thassa.

entities.name: The Monsoon
entities.description: Callaphe's living ship-serpent that carries Elspeth and Ajani toward the edge of the world.

entities.name: Callaphe
entities.description: A mythic navigator whose identity Kiora posed as; Thassa calls her her devotee.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods and mortals where Kiora fights Thassa.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Kiora's native plane, which she hopes to return to to fight the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: World-devouring creatures Kiora hopes to fight on Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan, whose memory twisted into the false god Cosi.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: The trickster god of Zendikar's merfolk, revealed as a twisted memory of Kozilek.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A false god of Zendikar, proved monstrous and deceitful.

entities.name: Ula
entities.description: A false god of Zendikar, proved monstrous and deceitful.

entities.name: Tritons
entities.description: The merfolk of Theros who worship Thassa and watch her fight Kiora.

entities.name: The bident
entities.description: Thassa's signature weapon and her power over the sea, which Kiora steals.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The realm of the gods of Theros; Elspeth and Ajani seek to journey into it.

entities.name: Kruphix's temple
entities.description: Temple at the edge of the world that Elspeth and Ajani seek.

events.summary: Kiora leaps onto the back of Arixmethes and reveals to Ajani and Elspeth that she is not Callaphe, then leaves them to the Monsoon.
events.quote: "Not even close," Kiora replied, smiling back at him.

events.summary: Kiora dives beneath the waves as Thassa, as the Great Eye, bursts from the water.
events.quote: Kiora cast a spell to aid her swimming

events.summary: On the sea bed Kiora calls to the krakens and leviathans Thassa kept in the deep and summons sea-beasts from many worlds.
events.quote: she gathered to her the essence of every sea-beast she had ever called her own.

events.summary: Kiora rises with her armada and sees Thassa on the Monsoon; Thassa sends Elspeth and Ajani away on a great wave.
events.quote: Thassa stepped off the deck of the Monsoon

events.summary: Thassa shifts into her triton form and summons the krakens of Theros as Arixmethes sides with her.
events.quote: He was also, for the moment, on Thassa's side.

events.summary: The two armies clash as hundreds of tritons arrive to watch; Thassa taunts Kiora.
events.quote: "Bear witness to the fall of the pretender!"

events.summary: Kiora tries to wrest Arixmethes from Thassa by bonding with his mind, but fails.
Kiora's serpent turns on her and devours dozens of tritons, and half her krakens turn against her.
Kiora banishes her serpent and the traitor krakens and falls, cushioning her fall with roots and vines from the sea floor.
events.quote: she pulled roots and vines up out of ground that had never seen the sun

events.summary: Thassa parts the sea into an arena, accuses Kiora of leading her people astray, and pins her to a boulder with the thrown bident.
events.quote: It slammed into her and pinned her to one of the boulders

events.summary: Kiora takes the bident and planeswalks away with it, leaving Thassa crying out in anguish.
events.quote: melted away into the void, Thassa's weapon still clutched in her hands.

relations.note: Fights Thassa and steals her bident.

relations.quote: aided Elspeth, the Betrayer in her quest.
Elspeth Tirel and Ajani Goldmane, meanwhile, sought to journey into Nyx

relations.note: The tritons are her children and followers.
Sides with Thassa in the fight.
relations.quote: Thassa rode atop Arixmethes without holding on

relations.note: Cosi was a twisted memory of Kozilek.
relations.quote: a twisted memory of the Eldrazi titan Kozilek

relations.note: Thassa's signature weapon and power over the sea.
relations.quote: holding the bident that was her signature weapon and her power over the sea
